_comment: Browser MCP for the fetch backlog (see BROWSER-FETCH-RUNBOOK.md). Copy to .mcp.json so Claude Code auto-loads it in this repo:  cp .mcp.example.json .mcp.json  — then run:  npx playwright install chromium. For EU-geofenced sources from a non-EU box, add "--proxy-server=http://EU_HOST:PORT" to args (or route the whole box through an EU VPN).
